clear.comment: Generic clear button label (e.g. confirm clearing all frequency/association records).

save.comment: Save button in the custom-dictionary add/edit entry dialog.

customDictEnabled.comment: Toggle label: enable the user's custom dictionary in candidate suggestions.

customDictEnabledInfo.comment: Info-dialog body explaining what enabling the custom dictionary does.

values.hanji: 拍開了後，家己加入 ê 詞會出現佇候選詞內底。關起來了後，自訂詞就袂閣出現。
values.en: When on, words you add appear among the candidates. When off, your custom words no longer show up.

dataManagement.comment: Section title for personal-data management (backup/import/export of user data).

variantDictionary.comment: Toggle/section label for the variant-character (異用字) dictionary source.

khiin.comment: Toggle/section label for the Khiin (在來字) dictionary source.

customDictDescription.comment: Description of the custom-dictionary CSV format (column layout).

values.hanji: 自訂詞庫使用 CSV 純文字檔案，第 1 欄囥欲拍 ê 羅馬字，第 2 欄囥漢字，毋免囥標題。
values.en: The custom dictionary uses a plain-text CSV file: column 1 holds the romanization to type, column 2 holds the Hanji. No header row.

customDictEmpty.comment: Empty-state hint shown when the custom dictionary has no entries.

values.hanji: 揤 + 符號加入自訂詞
values.en: Tap + to add a custom word

romanLabel.comment: Field label for the romanization (拍字) column in the custom-entry dialog.

romanPlaceholder.comment: Placeholder example for the romanization field in the custom-entry dialog.

hanziLabel.comment: Field label for the Hanji (對應) column in the custom-entry dialog.

hanziPlaceholder.comment: Placeholder example for the Hanji field in the custom-entry dialog.

deleteAll.comment: Destructive action: delete all custom-dictionary entries.

deleteAllMessage.comment: Confirmation dialog body for deleting all custom-dictionary entries.

values.hanji: 敢確定欲刪除所有自訂詞？

customDictPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy warning against storing sensitive personal data in the custom dictionary.

values.hanji: 請毋通佇自訂詞庫囥敏感 ê 個人資料，親像身分證字號、口座密碼、信用卡號碼，請注意家己 ê 資訊安全。
values.en: Please do not store sensitive personal data in the custom dictionary, such as ID numbers, account passwords, or credit-card numbers. Mind your information security.

importCSV.comment: Button: import the custom dictionary from a CSV file.

exportCSV.comment: Button: export the custom dictionary to a CSV file.

exportSuccess.comment: Toast/dialog confirming the custom dictionary exported successfully.

importResult.comment: Import-result message: number of entries imported and number skipped (duplicates / overflow / write failures). Shared by custom-dictionary, frequency, and association imports (iOS importResultFormat).

values.hanji: 匯入 {imported} 項成功，{skipped} 項重複

invalidCSVFormat.comment: Error: the imported file is not valid CSV.

values.hanji: 檔案格式無正確，請使用 CSV 格式
values.en: Invalid file format. Please use CSV.

fileTooLarge.comment: Error: the imported file exceeds the 5 MB size limit.

tooManyEntries.comment: Error: the import exceeds the 30,000-entry cap.

importExportTitle.comment: Section title for the import/export controls.

frequencyExportCSV.comment: Button: export the word-frequency records to a CSV file.

frequencyImportCSV.comment: Button: import word-frequency records from a CSV file.

frequencyDescription.comment: Description of the word-frequency CSV format (column layout).

values.hanji: 詞頻紀錄使用 CSV 純文字檔案，第 1 欄囥詞，第 2 欄囥次數，毋免囥標題。
values.en: Frequency records use a plain-text CSV file: column 1 holds the word, column 2 holds the count. No header row.

associationExportCSV.comment: Button: export the word-association records to a CSV file.

associationImportCSV.comment: Button: import word-association records from a CSV file.

associationDescription.comment: Description of the word-association CSV format (5-column layout).

values.hanji: 詞關聯紀錄使用 CSV 純文字檔案，共 5 欄：頭前詞、頭前拍字、後壁詞、後壁拍字、次數，毋免囥標題。
values.en: Association records use a plain-text CSV file with 5 columns: previous word, previous romanization, next word, next romanization, count. No header row.

moeSectionTitle.comment: Section header grouping MOE dictionary sources.

otherSectionTitle.comment: Section header grouping non-MOE dictionary sources.

supplementSectionTitle.comment: Section header grouping supplementary dictionary data.

lkkDict.comment: Display name of the Han-Lo recommended-character dictionary source.

devSupplementDict.comment: Display name of the developer supplement dictionary file.

kautianAccentTainan.comment: MOE dictionary accent sub-source: Tainan mixed accent.

kautianAccentKaohsiung.comment: MOE dictionary accent sub-source: Kaohsiung mixed accent.

kautianAccentKinmen.comment: MOE dictionary accent sub-source: Kinmen Quanzhou-leaning accent.

kautianAccentMakung.comment: MOE dictionary accent sub-source: Makung Quanzhou-leaning accent.

kautianAccentSintik.comment: MOE dictionary accent sub-source: Hsinchu Quanzhou-leaning accent.

searchPlaceholder.comment: Search-field placeholder in the dictionary browser.

noResults.comment: Empty-state message when a dictionary search returns nothing.

frequencyManagement.comment: Page/section title for word-frequency record management.

frequencyRecordingEnabled.comment: Toggle label: enable recording of word-selection frequency.

frequencyRecordingEnabledInfo.comment: Info-dialog body explaining what frequency recording does for candidate ranking.

values.hanji: 拍開了後，齒盤會記錄你揀過 ê 詞幾擺，予候選詞排序做參考，定定揀 ê 詞就會排較頭前，按呢候選詞就會愈來愈準。
values.en: When on, the keyboard records how often you pick each word and uses it to rank candidates. Words you choose often move toward the front, so the candidates get more accurate over time.

associationManagement.comment: Page/section title for word-association record management.

associationRecordingEnabled.comment: Toggle label: enable recording of word-association (bigram) data.

associationRecordingEnabledInfo.comment: Info-dialog body explaining what association recording does for next-word prediction.

values.hanji: 拍開了後，齒盤會記錄頭前、後壁 ê 關聯詞，予連紲建議愈來愈準。
values.en: When on, the keyboard records which words follow which, making continuous suggestions more accurate over time.

frequencyPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy warning about sharing word-frequency data for research.

values.hanji: 詞頻紀錄對台語研究來講是真有價值 ê 資料。若欲提供予人研究訓練模型，請先刪除敏感 ê 私人資料。紀錄功能嘛會使關起來，毋過按呢候選詞 ê 排序就會較無準。
values.en: Frequency records are valuable data for Taiwanese-language research. If you share them for research or model training, please delete sensitive private data first. You can also turn recording off, though candidate ranking will then be less accurate.

clearAllFrequency.comment: Destructive action: delete all word-frequency records.

associationPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy warning about sharing word-association data for research.

values.hanji: 詞關聯紀錄對台語研究來講是真有價值 ê 資料。若欲提供予人做研究，請先刪除敏感 ê 內容。紀錄功能嘛會使關起來，毋過後一詞預測會較無準。
values.en: Association records are valuable data for Taiwanese-language research. If you share them for research, please delete sensitive content first. You can also turn recording off, though next-word prediction will then be less accurate.

clearAllAssociation.comment: Destructive action: delete all word-association records.

clearFrequencyMessage.comment: Confirmation dialog body for deleting all word-frequency records.

values.hanji: 確定欲刪除所有詞頻紀錄？

clearAssociationMessage.comment: Confirmation dialog body for deleting all word-association records.

values.hanji: 確定欲刪除所有詞關聯紀錄？

noData.comment: Empty-state message when a record list has no data.

filterHint.comment: Hint explaining the 100-item display cap and pointing to the search field.

values.hanji: 頂面上濟顯示 100 个詞，若揣無詞，請用下跤 ê「拍字揣詞」功能搜揣。
values.en: At most 100 words are shown above. If you cannot find a word, use the "Type to search" field below.

backupRestore.comment: Section title for full backup/restore of all user data.

exportBackup.comment: Button: export a full backup of all user data in one file.

importBackup.comment: Button: import a full backup of all user data from one file.

exportBackupSuccess.comment: Toast/dialog confirming the full backup exported successfully.

importBackupResult.comment: Backup-import result message: counts of custom-dictionary, frequency, and association records imported.

values.hanji: 匯入 {customDict} 項自訂詞、{frequency} 項詞頻、{association} 項詞關聯
values.en: Imported {customDict, plural, one {# custom entry} other {# custom entries}}, {frequency, plural, one {# frequency record} other {# frequency records}}, {association, plural, one {# association record} other {# association records}}

backupPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy note that backup files contain all usage records and are cross-platform.

values.hanji: 備份檔案內底包含你所有 ê 使用紀錄，佇 iOS 佮 Android 攏通用，準講換機仔嘛毋免煩惱。
values.en: Backup files contain all your usage records and work on both iOS and Android, so you need not worry when switching phones.
